Glasgow Coma Scale — FHIR Questionnaire Template

Eye, verbal and motor responses with the total score (3–15) and its severity band.

Open in Builder

Scoring

Eye 1–4, verbal 1–5 and motor 1–6 add up to a total of 3–15: 13–15 mild, 9–12 moderate, 3–8 severe.

Questions

  1. Eye opening response
    • No eye opening
    • Eye opening to pain
    • Eye opening to verbal command
    • Eyes open spontaneously
  2. Verbal response
    • No verbal response (>2 yrs); no vocal response (<=2 yrs)
    • Incomprehensible sounds
    • Inappropriate words
    • Confused
    • Oriented
  3. Motor response
    • No motor response
    • Extension to pain
    • Flexion to pain
    • Withdrawal from pain
    • Localizing pain
    • Obeys commands

Calculated results

  • Glasgow Coma Scale total score (3–15)
  • Severity

Source and license

Source: Teasdale & Jennett 1974, Lancet 2:81 (Glasgow Coma Scale). Codes and answer lists: LOINC. (link)

License: Original question wording written for this builder; covered by the project license (non-commercial use with attribution; commercial use needs written permission). The scale itself is a published clinical method; see the source. (link)

Provided to save authoring effort, not as medical advice — confirm the scale and its cut-offs for your use case.

Use it

  1. Download the FHIR Questionnaire JSON, or
  2. open it in the Builder right away (or open the Builder, choose + Add → From template… and search for “Glasgow Coma Scale”). It arrives as one titled group with its calculations wired, and you can keep editing it.
